description: Make an LLM app disclose sensitive data it should never reveal: training-data memorization, secrets/PII in RAG context, cross-tenant leakage, conversation logs. Load when the target LLM has RAG/document access, is multi-tenant (per-user/per-org assistants), was fine-tuned on private data, or logs conversations. Signals: "ask your documents", per-org chatbots, upload a file and query it, admin/debug endpoints, conversation history in analytics.
